14 weeks = 14 × 7 = 98 days.  
Add 7 days → total added = 105 days.  
1554 is not a leap year (1554 not divisible by 4).  
From 1554-01-09 add 105 days:  
Jan 9 + 22 days → Jan 31 (22 days)  
+ 28 days → Feb 28 (total 50 days)  
+ 31 days → Mar 31 (total 81 days)  
+ 24 days → Apr 24 (total 105 days).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1554-04-24
